name: Police Cadet Program
what_you_do: Meet on Tuesdays at 5:00 PM. Cadets serve a three-month probation with community service.
who_can_apply: Age 14 and older, and you must have finished 8th grade. Stay in school until you graduate. Keep at least a C average. No serious police record.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Cadets are volunteers, not police employees.
duration: Weekly meetings every Tuesday at 5:00 PM
deadline_text: Orientations are held twice a year, before the school year and after winter break. Specific dates are not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Complete the Cadet Application Packet and bring it to testing night. Use the APPLY NOW link on the page. For recruitment, call 602-534-2677.
notes: New cadets serve a three-month probation. During that time they must do 8 hours of community service each month. At 18, cadets can apply for non-sworn positions, such as Police Assistants.
